responsibility: Repository-local schema, synthetic example and documentation validation. No chatbot, importer, reader, database or shared runtime service.
unsupported_methods: Unimplemented HTTP methods use the standard-library 501 response, outside the JSON API envelope; no operation is executed.

routes.operation: Read this fixed interface manifest with current source snapshot.
Read built-in schema/example pairs; malformed local schemas are rejected.
Read saved receipts, current source match and browser-gate status.
Validate a document against one fixed built-in schema ID.
Validate this repository's schema/example set, catalog and architecture markers; body must be {}.

outcomes.200: Operation executed; status pass/fail describes local validation, not data truth or browser acceptance.
outcomes.400: Malformed JSON, request shape, framing, excessive depth or disallowed command/path/purpose/ACL fields.
outcomes.403: Invalid or duplicate Host/Origin; no authorization changes are performed.
outcomes.404: Unknown fixed route or schema ID, including unrecognized schema_id types.
outcomes.500: Invalid/unreadable local source; sanitized error, no traceback or private path in the response.

browser_input_limit: The JS editor rejects non-finite numbers and integer-valued numbers beyond Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER to avoid silently rounding synthetic IDs. Use string identity values. This does not narrow the native JSON/API numeric parser.

library.output: list[str] diagnostics; [] means supported local rules matched; invalid schemas return diagnostics.
list[str] diagnostics for the supported subset; unsupported validation keywords are errors.
list[str] repo diagnostics; root is trusted library/test configuration, never accepted from the web.
validation_response_schema; RequestError carries a 400/404 status for invalid request shapes or IDs.

cli.input: Fixed repository files only; no arbitrary path, command, endpoint or database arguments.
cli.stdout: Schema/example counts and local catalog/architecture result; not a system or browser acceptance verdict.

library_compatibility: Only listed library entries are supported. Other adapter helpers are internal and do not define a cross-repo package interface.

semantics.source_and_original_text: Schema/examples are local fixtures. Sources/materials in query-result are objects without enforced inner provenance fields; validation does not authenticate the source or quote.
semantics.time: Input timestamp fields are strings only; no UTC/range/ordering validation is implied. observed_utc in the result is validation time, not source event time.
semantics.identity_and_scope: message/conversation/run/source IDs are opaque contract values. No cross-platform identity, authorization or database scope is inferred.
semantics.policy_acl_purpose: No user-supplied ACL or purpose changes. Additional top-level execution/ACL/purpose/path fields are rejected; a purpose field inside a knowledge-gap document is only classification data, not an authorization grant. HTTP Host/Origin checks protect only the local inspector.
semantics.repeat_and_revision: Read-only repeated input has a stable canonical input_sha256 and same assertions; request_id/time may differ. Revisions must be explicitly resubmitted; source changes invalidate old receipts.
semantics.version_binding: Match exact HEAD, branch and source_fingerprint; api_version identifies this envelope, not the payload schema version or a global acceptance snapshot.

dependencies.runtime: Python 3.11+ standard library; same-repo validator and fixed files only.
dependencies.downstream_consumers: No runtime consumer is wired here. ssr-chat/ssr-knowledge keep independent contract copies; coordination is required before any exchange.

compatibility: api_version is additive. Existing payload schemas are unchanged; no HGPT importer Evidence-to-reader Record transformation or shared schema is invented.
browser_gate: Actual opening and operation in the user's default browser is required; currently blocked, not replaced by CLI, memory-handler or mock-DOM tests.
